description.zh: 自动销账金额，如果开启自动销账，此字段必填。只可以选择100、500、1000
description.en: The automatic write-off amount. This parameter is required if automatic write-off is enabled. Valid values: 100, 500, and 1000.

description.zh: true开启自动销账并设置自动销账金额，false关闭自动销账
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic write-off and set the automatic write-off amount. Valid values:
- true: enables automatic write-off and sets the automatic write-off amount.
- false: disables automatic write-off.

description.zh:
多语言参数，不传默认英文
en：英文
zh：中文
ja：日文
description.en:
The language of the response. Default value: en. Valid values:
- en: English.
- zh: Chinese.
- ja: Japanese.
